skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Cover Mercenary
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Cover Mercenary. Clothes Quartz wore when she was invited to a magazine shoot. Minimalist yet stylish, daring yet elegant. A mercenary's aura adds a touch of mystique to this outfit.
skins.quote: Quartz nearly fell over the first time she put on high heels, but she quickly got used to them, going back to her usual cool self in front of the camera—Oh no, she's not trying to look cool, she just doesn't know what expression to make! Go help her, quick!
